content.title: AirPods Pro 3
content.text: Removes up to 2x more unwanted noise than AirPods Pro 21 Removes up to 4x more unwanted noise than original AirPods Pro14 Adaptive EQ tunes music to your ears in real time based on the fit of your AirPods. Inward-facing microphones measure what you’re hearing, then adjust the low to high frequencies of a song — so you get consistently detailed playback, every time. Personalized Spatial Audio uses the TrueDepth camera on your iPhone to create a custom profile based on the geometry of your head, delivering deeply immersive sound tailored to you. Dynamic head tracking makes conversations feel like they’re happening in the same room — whether you’re gaming with friends or hosting a Group FaceTime call with family.19 Fitness app. With just AirPods Pro 3 and iPhone, you can dive into the new workout experience in the Fitness app, which includes things like walking, cycling, and HIIT. You can set your favorite music and podcasts to play automatically when you start a workout. With the new Apple Intelligence–enabled Workout Buddy feature, you can get personalized messages that keep you going.20 And with access to your Move ring — and even the Burn Bar in Fitness+ — you might just never stop. IP57 dust, sweat, and water resistance. A first for AirPods, an IP57 rating means AirPods Pro 3 are more durable than ever.10 Thanks to precision engineering combined with robust testing, you can feel confident during even the sweatiest workouts. Available in select languages and regions. For more information, see Feature Availability. With Live Translation, powered by Apple Intelligence, you can listen to people speaking in different languages and hear translations through your AirPods Pro 3. To respond, just speak naturally, and your words will appear in the other person’s language on your iPhone screen. To make the experience even more magical, if you both have AirPods Pro 3, you can each speak in your own language and hear translations through your AirPods.5 Announce Notifications. Siri can read out messages and alerts as they arrive, and you can respond with just your voice.24 With Siri Interactions, you can even use intuitive head gestures — like a nod or a shake — to answer or ignore calls and texts. Audio Sharing. Easily share what you’re watching or listening to with a friend.25 Just bring their AirPods near the iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV you’re connected to. And voilà. Easily locate the exact place you left your AirPods Pro.
